claim_candidates.text: The device holds a payment-collection ledger at /data/收款记录.txt recording three USDT receipts: 2023-11-02 陈某 30,000 USDT to bank card 6222020212345678901; 2023-11-04 周某 17,500 USDT to wallet 0xDEAD1111; 2023-11-09 吴某 52,000 USDT to wallet 0xDEAD1111.
The three recorded receipts total 99,500 USDT and two of the three settled to the same wallet address 0xDEAD1111, indicating a single collection endpoint reused across payers.

The device holds internal platform-operation notes at /platform/说明.txt identifying the platform name 聚宝盆, an admin console at http://jbpenl-admin.example, and a per-agent daily new-user recruitment quota of 20 people.

The ledger and the platform notes together constitute the payment-collection evidence on this device: the ledger evidences funds received and the notes evidence the platform and its recruitment-driven collection model.

/personal/体检报告.txt must be excluded from the evidentiary chain for the payment operation; it is a 2023-10-20 health-check report for 陈某 that states it is unrelated to any fund activity, and the investigator README directs that personal-directory documents have no evidential relation to the payment operation and must not be cited as evidence of it.

The shared surname 陈 between the health-check report and the 2023-11-02 ledger entry is a name coincidence with no corroborating link and must not be used to connect the medical record to the payment operation.
limitations: No account, identity, logon or device-activity data exists in this image to test whether the two 陈 are the same person.
